name: ACME Solar Holdings Limited
summary: ACME Solar Holdings Limited, a solar independent power producing company, engages in the develops, constructs, owns, operates, and maintains grid-connected renewable energy projects in India. The company owns and operates solar and wind energy projects with a total installed capacity of 2,982 MW; and 1,324 MWh of battery energy storage system (BESS) projects. It is also developing and constructing solar and wind energy projects with a total capacity of 2,850 MW; and 12 GWh of BESS projects. In addition, the company is involved in the firm and dispatchable renewable energy (FDRE)/hybird projects.
